title: Ghostly Projection
description: A woman in a black evening gown recoils in terror as a translucent glowing male ghost emerges from an old film projector, its beam projecting onto her body. The opulent room is in chaos with scattered film reels, popcorn, and torn movie posters littering the floor amid dramatic red curtains.
prompt: A terrified woman in a sleek black evening gown and heels dramatically recoils as a luminous blue-green ghostly male figure emerges from a large vintage film projector, its beam of light projecting the ghost onto her. Ornate room filled with scattered film reels, popcorn, broken picture frames and torn movie posters, heavy red velvet curtains, cinematic lighting with strong volumetric rays, dramatic and spooky atmosphere, detailed digital painting
